messages:
Maya (Finance Ops): Heads up — incoming GBP wire hit our account this morning for £12,450 but there's no clear remittance/invoice ref in the bank line. payer name is "Acme Apps Trading" rather than the legal name on the invoice. :eyes:

Eli (Payments): Can you paste the bank feed line? sometimes the narrative has a PO or short ref we can match on. :mag:

Maya (Finance Ops): Sure — copying the raw feed:```\nBeneficiary: Redwood Inference Ltd\nAmount: £12,450.00\nValue date: 2026-02-28\nPayment ref: PAY12345\nPayer: Acme Apps Trading\nBank ref: 55-998-774\n```:thinking_face:

Jordan (Account Exec): The amount matches INV-2026-337 but the customer used their trading name and PAY12345 is an internal order ref on their side. They didn't include our invoice number. I asked them to send a remittance screenshot and the PO number (their PO should map to our invoice).

Sam (Support): Quick checklist for recon: 1) Search invoices by amount + payer name variations. 2) Check linked customer account for outstanding balance. 3) If found, apply provisional match and flag until remittance arrives. 4) If not found, hold and escalate to customer.

Eli (Payments): I tried a fuzzy match on amount + date + sort code and matched to INV-2026-337 in the ledger but VAT breakdown differs (they paid net + VAT?), can you confirm their VAT number? If VAT mismatch, we can't finalize allocation without confirmation.

Maya (Finance Ops): Their payment included a VAT element but their remittance note missing. I emailed the AP contact requesting: invoice number, purchaser PO, and a PDF remittance. Also asked them to confirm VAT number.

payments-bot: New bank transaction captured — tx_id: BTX-20260228-77891. (attached metadata: amount=12450, currency=GBP, creditor_name=Redwood Inference Ltd, counterparty=Acme Apps Trading)

Jordan (Account Exec): If we can't get remittance in 48h, we need to open a disputes ticket and mark invoice as "pending - customer confirm" in billing portal so dunning doesn't trigger. I'll notify the customer success manager.

Sam (Support): For the support playbook: include repro steps so payments team can replicate search:```\n1) Payments UI -> Bank feed -> filter currency=GBP, date=2026-02-28\n2) Search description for "Acme" or payer name variations\n3) Cross-ref tx_id BTX-20260228-77891 with ledger entries for £12,450\n4) If ambiguous, create internal note and set invoice status to pending_remittance\n```

Eli (Payments): Also ping ops to check if the payer used an intermediary bank that stripped the remittance. I saw a missing field: beneficiary narrative sometimes truncated by correspondent bank. If so, we'll need the payer to include invoice id in the payment reference in future (provide format: INV-<year>-<number>).

Maya (Finance Ops): Agreed — I'm sending them suggested reference format and the PO requirement reminder. Will update here when they respond. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Account Exec): Thanks — please tag me when they send the remittance so I can apply and close the loop with customer.

Maya (Finance Ops): Update: customer sent a screenshot, contains their PO but not our invoice id. PO=PO-99321 and confirms VAT GB999888777. I've provisionally matched to INV-2026-337 and added internal memo referencing BTX-20260228-77891. Leaving pending until finance signs off.

Eli (Payments): OK to finalize provisional allocation but leave "awaiting remittance" flag. Documented steps for future: require payer to include either invoice id or PO+amount+date in transfer details. I'll add to payments SOP.

Sam (Support): Noted; I'll add a KB article for ASKs from customers who claim they've paid but no ref included. Include example email template requesting remittance and PO and explain how we match.

Maya (Finance Ops): Closing here — allocation done as provisional. Filing follow-up: update invoice with payer VAT (GB999888777) and mark as closed once reconciliation batch confirms. Will re-open if any discrepancy. :white_check_mark:
